name: lean-harness-local
description: Local marketplace for the lean AIDLC kernel and a separate org-policy plugin. Policy skills do not count against the kernel's 12-skill budget.

plugins.name: lean-harness
plugins.description: Lean AIDLC kernel: intent → spec → plan → review, ledger, and five hook bindings.

plugins.name: org-policy
plugins.description: Organization policy skills (security, brand, UX). Install beside lean-harness. Replace the example text with the policy owner's source of truth before treating it as binding.
